content:
One of the best AI transcription apps on Mac just got even better, with a major update that introduces a redesigned transcription editor and major performance gains. Here's the details.

MacWhisper 14 is here

If you haven't heard of MacWhisper yet, it's an excellent app from prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.

Users can quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings and system audio directly on their Mac using locally-running AI models, including OpenAI's Whisper and Nvidia's super-fast Parakeet.

I use it every day in both the pre and post production workflows of my podcast and can't recommend it enough.

Since launching MacWhisper in 2023, Bruin has continued to expand the feature set, improve the workflow, and bring numerous performance improvements.

MacWhisper 14 continues in that direction with a redesigned editor, faster performance, and a handful of other tweaks.

Here's Bruin on today's update:

Bruin says MacWhisper 14.1 is already out based on early user feedback, fixing and refining a number of details in the new editor. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a cloud transcription provider, letting users bring their own Gladia API key for transcription.

MacWhisper 14 also includes:

Redesigned AI services screen for a cleaner experience; updated AI models across popular providers; improved playback experience when handling multiple open transcripts at once; transcription window refinements including smoother Cmd+A actions and snappier editor interactions; Deepgram enhancements including EU/US region selection, filler word controls, and expanded Nova 3 language support; cloud transcription uploads without loading the entire file into memory; fixes for menu bar positioning, audio/video scrubber sync, high idle CPU usage, and meeting recording edge cases

MacWhisper Pro users can upgrade to version 14 for free. Bruin is also currently offering 14% off for users looking to upgrade to Pro.
